page.layout: One page of text, right of the gutter; the left edge shows the neighbouring page's fragments (not transcribed). Signature "A 4" at the foot.

main_text.p: am lingvæ Latinæ, produćto Gronovii libello, traduxisset. Eoqve consilium mutavi, cogitando illud Vespasiani: Non oportere, maledici senatoribus: remaledici civile fasqve esse. Atqve licet morbus vetare videretur & aurem velleret Celsus lib. 3. cap. 5. monens: ægros securos agere debere, ut, si corpore, non etiam

page.notes: The text is set in roman with long s printed as s; "s" not used. Words with ligatures and special forms (æ, ǫ-type q abbreviations rendered as qv) are copied as printed. Parts of the left-hand page (fragments such as "fol", "dole", "illos") are the edge of the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Doubtful: "fasqve" and "Eoqve" read as printed; the line "ægros securos" is copied as printed. The catchword "tiam" is taken as the last word at the foot, after the signature line.
